title: I gave someone my code / OTP / PIN

steps.text: Call your bank now, on the number on the back of your card. Tell them you shared a code with someone.
Ask them to block your card and stop any payments you didn't make.
If someone calls you back saying they're from the bank, hang up. Call the number on your card yourself.
Over the next few days, check your bank account. Call the bank about anything you don't recognise.

action.label: Ask my family to check with me

args.reason: Mum shared a code and has called the bank. Please help her check her account over the next few days.
